P|object-description|A small racing car with a metallic blue body, orange cockpit, and rubber tires.

P|object-description|Richard Sapper’s stainless steel espresso maker, with a handle that locks the body closed.
P|object-description|A softly rounded wall clock that lets the hands do the talking.
P|object-description|Red blades and blue and yellow handle loops give this everyday cutting tool a primary-color palette.
P|object-description|A refillable steel lighter with a hinged lid and a tactile opening mechanism.
P|object-description|Ettore Sottsass’s turned-wood mill, one of the small sculptural objects in the Twergi collection.
P|object-description|A colorful pocket tin containing playing cards, ready to take a game with you.
P|object-description|Alexander Girard’s bold color blocks, woven in virgin wool by Pendleton.
P|object-description|A folding umbrella with a striped canopy and a matching case.
P|object-description|A collection of sculptural lamps with pleated forms and bold colors, inspired by pop culture.
P|object-description|A small stool with a lift-off seat that reveals hidden storage. It doubles as a side table.
